senses.gloss: m. pl. (הדר) procession. א׳ צלמא a procession in which an idol is carried.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:11:4">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43ᵇ</cite> bot.; Y. Ber. II, 4ᵇ <he>אה׳ צילמי׳</he>; Y. Shek. II, end, 47ᵃ <he>דארורא צילמא</he> (read <he>אדורי דצ׳</he>); Midr. Sam. ch. XIX <he>צלמא הורדוסיס</he>(?).
